purpose: Add a bounded read-only Creative Tension and Challenger reasoning kernel that keeps artistic tradeoffs provisional, authenticates counter-habit experiments against canonical local suggestion context, and keeps simulated audience inference structurally separate from provenance-bearing observed audience evidence.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect competing creative values, a bounded counter-habit experiment, and audience evidence without N0TE silently converting hypotheses, simulation, technical evidence, or prior success associations into artistic truth or action authority.
lineage.capability: Creative tension, Challenger, and simulated-vs-observed audience reasoning kernel

why_now: Global reselection found canonical REQ-SCOPE-158 retained and consumer-incomplete while exact Song/Version identity, Twin evidence, deterministic local creative suggestions, Learning/Success association memory, and provenance primitives already existed. The activation is reconstructed from the exact post-Song-Reference-closure STABLE governance truth. Main then advanced to 0543f2fa947cd8b950831c9b8a5f3d17fd94c1a5 through the independently verified Relevance Broker kernel, which changed only n0te2/relevance_broker.py and its two focused tests and did not modify governance or Creative Tension files. Automated review of the first Creative Tension diagnostic candidate exposed missing construction authority, fabricated suggestion admission, malformed observed timestamps, and non-finite confidence; this receipt governs the repaired candidate only.
instead_of_what: Do not add a market-score oracle, audience hit predictor, automatic recommendation engine, provider call, DAW mutation, durable taste promotion, or shared ConsumerShell/HeadquartersMemory wiring while those seams are separately owned. Build only the truth-preserving independent kernel and prove it adversarially.

implementation_contract.tension_truth: Competing artistic values are HYPOTHESIS only. Technical evidence may describe state and Creative evidence may describe intent, but neither selects the artistic winner or turns irregularity into defect truth.
implementation_contract.challenger_truth: A Challenger experiment may use only current canonical association-only Success synthesis plus the exact current deterministic local WILDCARD suggestion re-derived from canonical Song/Session context. Fabricated, stale, provider-executed, action-authorized, foreign-Song, or non-Wildcard suggestion objects fail closed.
implementation_contract.audience_truth: SIMULATED_FIRST_LISTEN is inference only. OBSERVED_AUDIENCE requires a valid timezone-aware observation timestamp and source provenance. The lanes remain separate even when they disagree; no blended score, market certainty, or hit prediction is produced.
implementation_contract.numeric_truth: Audience confidence and evidence confidence must be finite numeric values inside the declared 0 through 1 boundary; NaN and infinities are invalid rather than silently comparable.
implementation_contract.mutation: All outputs are frozen, ephemeral, non-durable and non-authorizing. The kernel performs no provider/DAW action, Song/Version mutation, approval, Learning decision, preference promotion, publication, spend, or external write.

completion_proof: technical and creative evidence stay in distinct Twin lanes and never decide an artistic winner
only exact canonical active EvidenceMemory claims for the current profile/Song/Version are admissible
canonical association-only Success patterns can produce a bounded Challenger experiment while stale/fabricated/causal-upgraded patterns fail closed

the Challenger suggestion must equal the exact deterministic current-context WILDCARD produced by CreativeSuggestionService; fabricated prompt, semantic key, session context, provider execution or action authority fails closed
observed audience evidence rejects missing, malformed, timezone-naive and non-time observed_at values
audience confidence rejects booleans, NaN, infinities and values outside 0 through 1
simulated and observed audience lanes remain structurally separate with disagreement preserved and no blended market score
kernel reads do not mutate canonical store state or create a new persistence owner
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at the exact repaired head on Linux, Windows and macOS
non_scope: durable creative-tension storage or automatic Artist World/taste promotion
market certainty, hit prediction, audience score or simulated-observed evidence blending
provider calls, external audience scraping or provider-verified evidence minting
DAW mutation, audio processing, publication, spend or external-write authority
automatic artistic winner selection or correctness/defect verdicts
marking UX-01 DONE or claiming full REQ-SCOPE-158 completion
shared_integration_points: No shared composition root in this increment. Reuse existing LineageStore, EvidenceMemory, SuccessMemory/Learning SessionMemory and CreativeSuggestionService semantics only.
next_selection_rule: After exact-head proof and integration, close this bounded receipt, return UX-01 to PRESERVED, refresh live product truth and globally reselect. Consumer reachability remains separately selectable rather than automatically extending by adjacency.
